title: Settings › Nushell: add a way to choose nu, which two messages already tell the user to do
problem: When nu isn't found, fffinder points at a control that doesn't exist. Open Nushell Here warns 'Nushell (nu) was not found. Set its path in Settings.' (src/finder/mod.rs:2495) and the Nushell panel says '...Set its location in Settings.' (mod.rs:2739). Settings › Nushell only prints 'Using <path>' or 'nu was not found on PATH or in the usual install locations.' (src/finder/dialogs.rs:535-540). The path can only be set by hand-editing `nu_path` in settings.json (crates/fffinder-core/src/config.rs:277), and it is read once at startup (`nushell::find_nu` at src/lib.rs:93), so a restart is also needed and nothing says so. This is not a rare case: an app started from the Dock or a desktop launcher doesn't get the shell's PATH, so a nu installed by nix, mise or asdf is missed. Without nu, filters (src/finder/filter.rs:114), renaming several items (src/finder/batch_rename.rs:69-77), the Nushell panel and Nushell colors are all off.
proposal: Add `Finder::set_nu_path(&mut self, path: Option<PathBuf>, cx)`: set `self.config.nu_path` and call `settings_changed(cx)`; recompute `cx.global_mut::<AppState>().nu = nushell::find_nu(self.config.nu_path.as_deref())`; call `apply_nu_environment(cx)` and `cx.refresh_windows()`. Every user of nu already reads `AppState.nu` at call time, so this applies live with no restart. In the Settings dialog, turn the line at dialogs.rs:535-540 into a `setting_row` with id `nu-path` on the text and two controls: `choose-nu`, 'Choose...': `cx.prompt_for_paths` with `files: true`, following `prompt_add_root` at dialogs.rs:619-638; `nu-auto`, 'Find Automatically': shown only when `config.nu_path` is set; clears it. If the chosen file can't be used (`find_nu` falls back to something else or to None), push a warning naming the file.
original_test_plan: Headless UI test in tests/controls.rs: create an empty file `fake-nu` in the fixture, open Settings, click `choose-nu`, assert `ui.cx.did_prompt_for_paths()`, and answer with `simulate_path_prompt_response(|_| Some(vec![fake]))`. Assert `ui.read(|f| f.config().nu_path.clone()) == Some(fake)`, that `cx.global::<AppState>().nu` equals it, and that `ui.snapshot("nu-path").label()` contains the path. Click `nu-auto` and assert `nu_path` is `None`.
original_risks: `AppState.nu` is shared by every window, so a Nushell job started just before the change keeps the old path, which is fine. Don't run `nu --version` on the UI thread to validate; `find_nu`'s existing `is_file` check is enough for a first version.

verifier.claim_check:
The problem is real and not handled anywhere; the proposal's "applies live" claim is only partly true. Read-only review, nothing was run.

**Confirmed**
- Open Nushell Here warns "Nushell (nu) was not found. Set its path in Settings." (src/finder/mod.rs:2491-2499). The Settings dialog's own "Try It" button (src/finder/dialogs.rs:1132-1148) raises it while Settings is open.
- The Nushell panel says "...Set its location in Settings." (mod.rs:2735-2744).
- Settings › Nushell only prints a text line from `AppState.nu` (dialogs.rs:351, 535-540). There is no control.
- Nothing in src writes `nu_path`: it appears only at crates/fffinder-core/src/config.rs:277, 330, 615 and src/lib.rs:93.
- `AppState.nu` is resolved once (lib.rs:93, 115-119). `Settings::reread_file` (src/settings.rs:149-161, called only from `Finder::new`, mod.rs:476) picks a hand-edited `nu_path` into `Config`, but `adopt_settings` (mod.rs:2312-2369) has no `nu_path` branch, so a restart is needed.
- The manual documents `nu_path` only as a settings.json field (docs/manual.md:1014, 1085) and never mentions a restart; line 1042 even says hand edits show in open windows.
- `find_nu` (src/nushell.rs:15-48) checks the configured file, `PATH`, `~/.cargo/bin`, `~/.local/bin`, Homebrew, `/usr/local/bin`, `/usr/bin`. It has no nix, mise, asdf or MacPorts folders.
- Without nu: filters (src/finder/filter.rs:112-116), batch rename (src/finder/batch_rename.rs:69-78), colors and editor (src/finder/editor.rs:19-23) and actions (mod.rs:2638-2640) are off.
- No test pins the current text, and CHANGELOG.md has no entry.

**Where the proposal is wrong**
- Callers do read `AppState.nu` at call time, but state derived from it is cached per browser:
  - Actions load once in `Finder::new` (mod.rs:665). They auto-reload only when `user_actions_stamp.is_some()` (mod.rs:1117), which is never set when nu was missing, so Nushell Actions stay empty after the change.
  - Other tabs, panes and windows keep their old `nu_env` and actions; the proposal re-applies only on `self`.
  - The preview cache (src/finder/preview.rs:311-317) and a filter error (filter.rs:113) stay stale.
- `setting_row` takes `&'static str` (dialogs.rs:245-249), so it cannot carry the dynamic path.
- `prompt_add_root` (dialogs.rs:619-638) has no window, so it cannot push a warning.
- The "`find_nu` fell back" warning is nearly unreachable: `find_nu` accepts any existing file (nushell.rs:16) and a file chooser returns one.
verifier.implementation_notes:
1. **`Finder::set_nu_path`** (pub, in src/finder/mod.rs beside `set_terminal_app` ~2600, or in editor.rs beside `set_use_nu_environment`):
   - Set `self.config.nu_path = path`, then call `self.settings_changed(cx)`. `nu_path` is a shared setting (config.rs:609-616), so other browsers get it through `adopt_settings`.
   - Compute `nushell::find_nu(self.config.nu_path.as_deref())` and write `cx.global_mut::<AppState>().nu` only if it differs.
   - Call `self.nu_changed(cx)`, then `cx.refresh_windows()` (same reason as src/finder/disk_access.rs:127).

2. **New private `Finder::nu_changed(cx)`**, the part the proposal missed:
   - `self.load_user_actions(cx)`. When nu is now `None`, clear `user_actions`, `user_actions_error` and `user_actions_stamp` instead.
   - `self.apply_nu_environment(cx)`.
   - `self.previews.clear()`, as `set_appearance` does.
   - If `!self.filter.is_empty()`: set `filter_source = None`, `filter_error = None`, and call `rebuild_rows(cx)` so the filter runs again.
   - `cx.notify()`.

3. **`adopt_settings`** (mod.rs:2344, next to the `use_nu_environment` branch): add `if self.config.nu_path != before.nu_path { self.nu_changed(cx) }`. The global is already updated by then, because observers run after the update that called `set_nu_path`.

4. **Recommended, 4 lines in `Finder::new`** (mod.rs:475-477): remember `settings.read(cx).config().nu_path` before `reread_file`. If it differs afterwards, set `AppState.nu = find_nu(...)`. This makes a hand edit apply when a tab or window opens, as manual.md:1042 promises, and keeps the status line truthful.
   - Pitfall: recompute only on a real `nu_path` change. The UI harness injects `AppState.nu` (tests/common/mod.rs:170-181), including a non-existent `/opt/nu/bin/nu` (tests/controls.rs:810).

5. **Settings row** (dialogs.rs:535-540): replace the text div with one `h_flex().gap(ui(8.))` line. Do not use a two-line `setting_row`.
   - Text: `div().id("nu-path").flex_1().min_w_0().truncate().text_size(ui(12.)).aria_label(full_text).child(text).test_support()`. This is the idiom at src/finder/bars.rs:392-396; add `use gpui_kit::TestSupportExt as _;`.
   - Status text from `(config.nu_path, AppState.nu)`:
     - "Using {p}" when found.
     - The existing not-found sentence when nothing is set or found.
     - "{chosen} wasn't found, so {p} is used" or "...and no other nu was found" when a chosen path isn't in use.
   - `Button::new("choose-nu").small().label("Choose…")` (house style, cf. "Add Folder…").
   - `Button::new("nu-auto").small().ghost()`, shown when `nu_path.is_some() || nu.is_none()`. Label it "Find Automatically" when a path is set, else "Look Again". Both call `set_nu_path(None, cx)`, which also covers nu installed after launch.

6. **`prompt_choose_nu(&mut self, window, cx)`**: copy `open_with_other` (src/finder/open_with.rs:72-86), not `prompt_add_root`.
   - Options: `files: true, directories: false, multiple: false, prompt: Some("Choose")`.
   - Use `cx.spawn_in(window, ...)` and `this.update_in`.
   - On `Ok(Ok(Some(paths)))` call `set_nu_path(paths.pop(), cx)`. Store the path as returned; do not canonicalize, because nix and mise paths are symlinks that must stay stable.
   - On `Ok(Err(err))` push a Warning. `--term` returns an error (src/term/platform.rs:131-137, 235-240) and so does Linux without a portal; `prompt_add_root` drops it silently.

7. **Validation**: keep to `find_nu`'s `is_file` for v1. This matches the custom terminal command and Open With › Other, which report errors at use. Drop the proposal's fallback warning in favour of the status line in step 5. A background `nu --version` probe via `nushell::run_raw` (nushell.rs:265) is an optional follow-up.

8. **Docs**:
   - docs/manual.md:1014: describe the Settings › Nushell buttons, and give the tip to paste `which nu` into the chooser (Cmd+Shift+G on macOS, Ctrl+L in GTK), since nix, mise and asdf folders are hidden.
   - manual.md:1085: update the `nu_path` row.
   - manual.md:764: add `nu_path` to the `--term` note.
   - CHANGELOG.md: add an entry under [Unreleased] › Added.
   - Optionally point filter.rs:114 and batch_rename.rs:73 at Settings too.
verifier.test_plan:
Headless harness in tests/common/mod.rs (`Fixture`, `Ui::open`, `ui.click`, `ui.snapshot`, `ui.exists`, `ui.window`, `ui.read`, `ui.update`, `ui.settle`, `cmd`). All tests below run on Linux, macOS and Windows without nu installed.

1. **tests/controls.rs, new `settings_chooses_nu`** (path-prompt helpers as at controls.rs:652-657):
   - Write an empty `fx.path("fake-nu")`, then `Ui::open` (so `AppState.nu` is `None`) and `ui.press(&cmd(","))`.
   - Assert `ui.snapshot("nu-path").label()` contains "not found".
   - `ui.click("choose-nu")`, then assert `ui.cx.did_prompt_for_paths()`.
   - Answer with `ui.cx.simulate_path_prompt_response(|o| { assert!(o.files && !o.directories && !o.multiple); Some(vec![fake.clone()]) })`, then `ui.settle()`.
   - Assert `ui.read(|f| f.config().nu_path.clone()) == Some(fake)`.
   - Assert `ui.window(|_, cx| cx.global::<AppState>().nu.clone()) == Some(fake)` (pattern at controls.rs:748).
   - Assert the `nu-path` label contains `fake.display()`.
   - Assert `ui.read(|f| f.user_actions_error().is_some_and(|e| e.contains("fake-nu")))`. This proves the actions were re-read with the new program: an empty file fails to spawn everywhere, and nushell.rs:349 puts the path in the error.
   - `ui.click("nu-auto")`: `nu_path` is `None` and the global equals `fffinder::nushell::find_nu(None)`.
   - Click `choose-nu` again and answer `|_| None`: nothing changes.
   - `ui.update(|f, _, cx| f.set_nu_path(Some(fx.path("gone")), cx))`: the label names "gone" as not found and `nu-auto` exists.

2. **tests/settings.rs** (uses `with_tabs` and `tabs`, lines 12-28): press `cmd("t")`, call `set_nu_path(Some(fake))` on tab 0, `ui.settle()`. Assert tab 1's `config().nu_path` and that its `user_actions_error()` mentions fake-nu (the `adopt_settings` hook).

3. **If step 4 of the plan is done, tests/settings_file.rs**: copy `a_new_tab_picks_up_a_hand_edit` (lines 78-97) with `nu_path: Some(fake)`, and assert `AppState.nu == Some(fake)` after `cmd("t")`.

4. **Optional unit test in src/nushell.rs `mod tests`**: `find_nu(Some(existing_file))` returns it, and `find_nu(Some(missing)) == find_nu(None)`.

5. **Re-run for layout**: `settings_text_sizes`, `settings_dialog_controls`, the terminal and nu-environment tests in controls.rs, and `the_sidebar_switches_between_list_and_tree` in tests/folder_tree.rs.
verifier.risks:
- **Settings dialog height (main risk).** Existing tests click Nushell-section controls without scrolling:
  - `nu-text-bigger` at 110% text size (tests/controls.rs:729-733).
  - `terminal-app` and `try-terminal` (controls.rs:831, 848).
  - `use-nu-env` (controls.rs:1716).
  - tests/folder_tree.rs:448 already has to scroll to reach `sidebar-list`.
  The click helper requires the element visible and clicks its unclipped centre (gpui-kit-0.8.1/src/test.rs:146-171). The dialog is capped at viewport height minus 32, which is 1048 px in the 1536×1080 headless window (gpui-component-0.8.1/src/dialog/dialog.rs:689). macOS adds an Applications row above (src/finder/dialogs.rs:403-424). I could not measure the remaining margin by reading. A two-line `setting_row` adds about 17 px; one line with small buttons adds about 6 px. Keep it to one line and check CI on all three systems.
- **Clobbering the injected nu.** Recomputing `AppState.nu` anywhere but on a real `nu_path` change overwrites the value the tests inject and breaks the terminal tests.
- **Wrong pick.** A chosen file that is not nu overrides working auto-detection (src/nushell.rs:16) until "Find Automatically" is clicked. Errors then name the path. This is acceptable for v1 but is the reason for the status line and the always-reachable reset.
- **Chooser availability.** It does nothing in `--term` and errors on Linux without xdg-desktop-portal, so the error must be surfaced and settings.json kept as the documented fallback.
- **Hidden folders.** System choosers hide `~/.nix-profile`, `~/.local/share/mise` and `~/.asdf`, which are the motivating cases. It works by pasting a path, so the manual must say so. A text field would be friendlier but is out of scope.
- **Synced settings.** `nu_path` is one field for all systems, unlike `terminals` (crates/fffinder-core/src/config.rs:255-258). A synced settings.json may carry a path missing on another machine; `find_nu` falls back, and the status line must say so.
- **UI-thread stats.** `find_nu` stats the `PATH` folders on the UI thread, as startup does, but only on a click.
- **macOS symlinks.** I could not confirm whether the macOS open panel resolves symlinks, because the mac platform crate is not in this Linux registry. If it does, a nix store path would go stale after an upgrade.
